evidence.title: Manitowoc County Ordinance No. 2026/2028-10, Amending Manitowoc County Code Ch. 8, Enacting a Moratorium on Data Centers (as adopted)

evidence.supports: Full signed ordinance text creating Manitowoc County Code Sec. 8.495: 18-month duration from publication, effective-upon-publication clause, and the April 28, 2026 County Board adoption date with Board Chair and County Executive signature lines.
evidence.quote: The moratorium shall be in effect for a period of 18 months from the date this ordinance is published (i.e. its effective date) or until the County Board adopts and the County Executive approves amendments to this ordinance or rescinds this moratorium, or both. ... BE IT FURTHER ORDAINED that this ordinance shall be effective upon publication. Dated this 28th day of April 2026.
